title.zh: 为朱洛港码头扩建与竣工拨款四千二百比索（菲律宾货币），并为在该码头及相连栈桥上修建有轨电车线路拨款的法案
title.en: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FOUR THOUSAND TWO HUNDRED PESOS, PHILIPPINE CURRENCY, FOR THE EXTENSION AND COMPLETION OF THE WHARF AT JOLO AND FOR THE CONSTRUCTION OF A TRAMWAY UPON THE WHARF AND PIER CONNECTED THEREWITH.
title.orig: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FOUR THOUSAND TWO HUNDRED PESOS, PHILIPPINE CURRENCY, FOR THE EXTENSION AND COMPLETION OF THE WHARF AT JOLO AND FOR THE CONSTRUCTION OF A TRAMWAY UPON THE WHARF AND PIER CONNECTED THEREWITH.
title.vi: Đạo luật cấp ngân sách bốn nghìn hai trăm peso tiền Philippines để mở rộng và hoàn thành cầu cảng tại Jolo và xây dựng tuyến xe điện trên cầu cảng và cầu tàu nối liền với nó
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดสรรงบประมาณจำนวนสี่พันสองร้อยเปโซสกุลเงินฟิลิปปินส์เพื่อขยายและดำเนินการให้แล้วเสร็จซึ่งท่าเทียบเรือที่โจโล และเพื่อก่อสร้างรางรถรางบนท่าเทียบเรือและท่าเทียบเรือที่เชื่อมต่อกัน
title.id: Undang-Undang mengalokasikan empat ribu dua ratus peso mata uang Filipina untuk perluasan dan penyelesaian dermaga di Jolo serta pembangunan jalur trem di atas dermaga dan dermaga yang terhubung dengannya
title.ms: Akta yang mengeluarkan peruntukan empat ribu dua ratus peso mata wang Filipina bagi pengembangan dan penyiapan sepenuhnya jeti di Jolo dan bagi pembinaan laluan trem di atas jeti dan jeti yang bersambung dengannya

text.en:
The sum of four thousand two hundred pesos, Philippine currency, is hereby appropriated, out of
any money in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the following purposes:
(a) Two thousand seven hundred pesos to be utilized for the extension thirty-six feet further of the wharf
recently built at Jolo.
(b) One thousand five hundred pesos to be expended for the building and equipping of a narrow-gauge
tramway from the sea end of said wharf to the custom house, including the purchase of materials necessary

The two thousand seven hundred pesos referred to in subsection (a) of section one hereof are
hereby made available for use by the engineer of the United States Army, who shall be or has been detailed
for this work by the commanding general of the Department of Mindanao. The one thousand five hundred
pesos referred to in subsection (b) of section one hereof are hereby made available for the use of the collector
of customs at the port of Jolo for the purposes in this Act provided.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, September 30, 1903.
